physical_default: HOLD; no physical work permitted by this review
branch_policy: R04–R11 are requests to qualified closed services, never low-level hardware commands. Core and optional paths keep separate states. R14 may close any started physical session after partial failure; it must join all actually started jobs, not wait only for successful R13.

steps.action: Approve the scientific and safety contract
guards: All safety-critical unknowns resolved before physical work; source outcomes excluded from action rewards
steps.failure_closeout: No physical action; unresolved branches remain held

steps.action: Receive qualified material and preparation evidence
guards: Preparation is not skipped: require full service receipt, measured dimensions/condition and sample identity
steps.failure_closeout: Quarantine ambiguous, damaged, unqualified or unmatched carrier; no attempt to repair chemically

steps.action: Register protected custody and pre-test condition
guards: Carrier supported before releasing previous holder; receiving occupancy and identity accepted
steps.failure_closeout: Keep last accepted holder; do not drop, place bare die on generic surface or claim transfer completed from a command

steps.action: Hand over and qualify the closed measurement configuration
guards: Named provider accepts sample custody; verify independent interlock/status evidence; no robot enters magnet zone
steps.failure_closeout: Freeze dependent requests; service owns safe containment and support; preserve lease until acknowledged

steps.action: Request initial Hall-bar and subarray characterization
guards: Cover MAIN Fig 3 and SI S1 as distinct paths; flag apparent plateau versus precision quantization; no per-element carrier values inferred
steps.failure_closeout: Preserve failed characterization and block precision interpretation; qualified provider decides disposition

guards: Reference/test identities and winding mapping explicit; current reversal is a provider-owned method; count readings without inventing chip replicates
steps.failure_closeout: Stop only by approved service action; retain partial/time-gap/fault evidence and no automatic restart

guards: 100-ohm standard heating/current limit independently qualified; source 3 mA is reference context, not safety permission
steps.failure_closeout: Hold reference-chain inference if reference drift, identity or stability is unacceptable

guards: Maintain two directed edges, common reference ID and time interval; do not treat as independent references
steps.failure_closeout: Partial completion remains per-edge; do not substitute one array result for the other

guards: Source includes both field signs and three magnitudes; hold exact cycle plan; no source direct HB_Array2 edge invented
steps.failure_closeout: Reject ambiguous sign/polarity mapping; keep all acquired results and service state

guards: This is an intentionally failing quantization condition, not equipment failure; qualified envelope still required; retain precision versus crude-plateau distinction
steps.failure_closeout: An unexpected physical state is handled by provider; scientific lack of quantization alone never triggers unbounded control escalation

guards: Separate 5–10-reading screen SD from long-record Allan SEM; high-current branch optional and held without approved performance-limit test contract
steps.failure_closeout: Abort/request containment per service policy at abnormal heating/current/contact/noise state; no autonomous attempt to reproduce paper maximum

steps.action: Request the external high-bias common-mode check
guards: Resolve SI 4 unknown array and 2-versus 2.1 K; distinguish subarray current from reference current; outcome bounds change only at its uncertainty
steps.failure_closeout: If reference or identities are unqualified, mark this branch unattempted/held and limit common-mode conclusions

steps.action: Validate each measurement bundle and approved analysis
guards: No printed Eq 3/Eq 4 execution until semantics resolved; no plot-digitized raw evidence; dependent optional branches analyzed only if actually acquired
steps.failure_closeout: Freeze derived claims for missing units/timestamps/reference; retain source and new-observation categories separately

steps.action: Evaluate the comparison network and coverage
guards: Five direct edge types and four connected nodes give three simple closed loops but only two independent graph cycles. Shared-reference relations do not establish statistically independent measurements or independent sample replication; do not claim exact absolute quantization from agreement alone.
steps.failure_closeout: Report disagreement and uncertainties without forcing zero or paper-matching results; unresolved/source-bug analysis stays held

steps.action: Close the service session and return custody
guards: Join every started service branch and pending job; require independently observed electrical-safe, accessible field-safe, warm/pressure-safe, motion-safe and support-safe state according to provider SOP; close leases only after acknowledged final custody
steps.failure_closeout: Maintain supported hold/quarantine and provider custody while any safety state or receiver acceptance is unverified
